note: Ready-made setups (plan F8): one click = pack + variant + add-ons, and GTA's own settings follow from the variant and the PC (gamesettings.json). 'pc' says what a PC needs (ramMinGB, vramMinGB, rtx, gpu: rtx50); 'rank' picks the best setup that fits a PC. 'testedOn': game builds a full play test passed on. leonida/setups.py reads it; `leonida setup list|best|choose|export|import|build`.
